about_the_game:
HumanityEcho is a new turn-based tactical RPG in a cyberpunk setting where your choices shape the city of tomorrow.

You are part of a dirty war for freedom in a decaying seaside megacity. Here, corporations play gods: they decide your fate, and your life is just a resource to them.
But the time has come to choose whether you’ll remain a puppet in the monsters’ hands or dare to become the hero who writes a new story.

  • Turn-based tactical combat - use cover, items, and abilities against dangerous enemies.

  • Implants & modifications - upgrade your body and weapons; design prototypes right in your own workshop.

  • Deep story & nonlinear narrative - your decisions reshape character fates, districts, and the balance of power in the city.

  • Cyberpunk locations - slums, resistance hideouts, corporate factories, and underground catacombs hiding dark secrets.

  • Network of interactive events - situations that arise during play force hard choices: spend resources, betray allies, or risk your life.

  • Combat rewards planning: think through positions, angles, timings, and exit routes.

  • Netrunning unlocks unconventional moves - shut down a sensor, tag a target, desync enemy teams.

  • Build loadouts to match your style by mixing implants and gear. In the end it’s simple: what will you choose - tactile sensation or tactical advantage?

  • Cobalt-chrome, a single controller, nine wires, and super-polymers - decide how to assemble something brilliant out of it.

  • Find rare components via contracts, barter, or salvaging trophies - no one just hands them over.

  • Install software into an implant’s OS, and remember: build quality affects stability, perks, and side effects.

  • Perks set the tempo: are you a sprinter who closes distance, or a “tank” who absorbs damage?

  • Attributes - Reaction, Vitality, Perception, Technical Aptitude - reinforce your path.
    Everyone’s a master of something, but you can grow in several directions: gunplay, netrunning, explosives, medicine, engineering. You can’t be the best at everything.

  • When your father disappears, truths he kept hidden begin to surface. This city has room for selfless help - giving without expecting anything back - and for intrigues spun in dark alleys.

  • The Resistance, the Order of Knights, and the corporations push you into conflict - deal with it in your own way. Your decisions change everything.

  • We wanted to capture the pleasure of views and atmosphere. Imagine: a rooftop, chill music, clouds drifting by; you’re on a worn-out sofa, and suddenly the silence matters more than the mission.

  • Beyond the city lies Mirror Lake near the Kreid-Wall: an icy surface with old tech compartments under the water; at the border, scanners and checkpoints that can reroute your path.

  • Pub “Nut,” port warehouses, the Panoramic Boulevard - familiar places from the future, each with its own rules and a cost of mistakes.

  • We are indie developers from Ukraine. We’re building a cozy corner of cyberpunk: where humanity stands next to neon, and language, jokes, food, and music feel like home.

  • We start with the vibe - wet asphalt, the smell of rubber at the playground, the warm light of late-night apartments - and move toward an immersive experience with micro-interactions and online play with friends.
    We do this so you can feel the city is alive, responsive, and yours.

  • Craft 2.0: more implants and technologies, real material trade-offs.

  • Dynamic environments in combat: greater mission variety and replayability.
    Clan building: personal rooms, workbenches, and upgrades that affect missions.

  • New stories and districts: the Port, the Dark Quarter, the Panoramic Boulevard - and 42 more locations. (We update the roadmap together with the community.)

  • The city glows in neon - and listens to your choice.

  • Like the vibe? Add HumanityEcho to your wishlist and drop by the community hub - we set build priorities together there.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS (64‑bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6500 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 960 — NVIDIA 470+ / RX 460 — Mesa 21.2+ / Intel Iris Xe — Mesa 21.2+
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS (64‑bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1060 (NVIDIA 535+) / RX 580 (Mesa 23+), Vulkan 1.1
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11 Big Sur (64‑bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (2015 or newer) / Apple Silicon (M1 or newer)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal 2–compatible GPU, 2 GB VRAM (Intel Iris 2015+ or Apple GPU), MoltenVK/Vulkan
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 13 Ventura
  • Processor: Apple Silicon (M2 or newer) / Intel Core i5 (2019 or newer)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M2 GPU or Radeon Pro 2018+, 4 GB VRAM, Metal 2
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
